purpose: Prevent orphan or cross-generation results by making every terminal return pin one exact task publication and durable execution record, preserving every historical generation as immutable provenance while deriving current task state only from the current publication generation.

publication_generation_semantics.historical_execution_validation: An immutable execution record validates against the exact task-publication generation named by its publication_id, not against whatever generation is current later.
publication_generation_semantics.current_task_state: For a registered task, task_result_state without an explicit publication_id derives state only from the current immutable publication generation.
publication_generation_semantics.historical_query: An explicit historical publication_id remains queryable for provenance and review history.
publication_generation_semantics.new_result_freeze: A newly frozen result still requires its execution record to belong to the current task publication generation.

persistence_boundary.execution_and_result: Create the execution provenance record and result record in the same bounded publication batch as the durable return/checkpoint whenever possible.
persistence_boundary.driver_review: Create the review record in the same bounded batch as the actual Driver review artifact whenever possible.
persistence_boundary.between_checkpoints: No routine repository writes, CI polling, review polling or scheduler heartbeat are required by result lifecycle.
